lead.headline: Apple Pay arrives in India, starting with Axis Bank credit cards
lead.short: Apple Pay went live in India on Wednesday on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, with support for the Mac to follow. At launch it takes only Axis Bank's Visa and Mastercard credit cards, for tap-to-pay in shops and for payments in apps and online. Apple names Blinkit, Croma, ixigo, Reliance brands, Tata 1mg and Zomato among the merchants.
more: RuPay cards are not supported, and HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank and SBI Card are not part of the launch; Apple says more banks will join. Payments use a device-specific number, so the card number is not shared with the shop.

why.text: Your Axis card can go into Apple Wallet today; the other cards in your wallet have to wait for their banks.

seconds.headline: Supreme Court questions tenfold hospital markups on medicines; hospital shares fall
seconds.byline: BAR AND BENCH · BUSINESS TODAY · 29–30 SEP
seconds.short: A bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Sandeep Mehta said corporate hospitals make admitted patients buy medicines from in-house pharmacies at inflated prices, citing a cancer drug that costs retailers ₹2,700 and sells for ₹27,000. It asked the Centre why the 16% retail margin in the 2013 Drug Price Control Order is not enforced and will hear the case again on 12 October.
more: Hospital stocks fell on Wednesday as investors weighed tighter rules on pharmacy pricing: Apollo Hospitals, Max Healthcare, Fortis, Aster DM and Medanta were down between about 5% and 9% by early afternoon.

why.text: If the court pushes the Centre to enforce the margin cap, hospital pharmacy bills, the biggest item on many insurance claims, would come down.

seconds.headline: Anthropic's prospectus shows revenue up twelvefold and an $8 billion operating loss
seconds.short: The 261-page filing, reported by Reuters on 28 September, shows 2025 revenue of $4.59 billion against $386 million a year earlier, and an operating loss that widened to $8.06 billion. The net loss of nearly $42 billion is mostly a one-off, non-cash charge of about $34 billion on financing that can convert into shares. Compute and infrastructure took $7.33 billion, about 58% of operating costs.
more: The company has about $518 billion of future cloud and computing commitments. It reported revenue of $11.5 billion in the second quarter of 2026 alone and a second straight quarter of adjusted operating profit. About 80 pages are risk factors, including warnings that advanced models could resist shutdown or hide information.

why.text: It is the first full look at what a frontier AI lab earns and spends, and the numbers every rival's valuation will now be set against.

seconds.headline: Election Commission drops the extra voter-form declaration two commissioners had objected to
seconds.byline: INDIAN EXPRESS · BUSINESS STANDARD · NDTV · 30 SEP
seconds.short: New voters in states where the roll revision is complete now fill only the statutory Form 6; the additional declaration has been removed from the ECINET app and the state portals. The change follows a full Commission meeting on 26 September, after reports that Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had objected on record at least 14 times to revision orders issued without them.
more: At an INDIA bloc meeting in Delhi on Wednesday, Mallikarjun Kharge called for a return to paper ballots and for the pre-revision rolls to be used in future elections; the bloc listed six demands. The Supreme Court is due to hear a plea to suspend the Chief Election Commissioner next week.

why.text: The first decision the Commission has reversed since its own members' objections became public.

facts.status: SC to hear suspension plea next week

seconds.headline: Blast at the Mangaluru refinery sends up thick smoke and shakes nearby homes
seconds.byline: DECCAN HERALD · TIMES OF INDIA · 30 SEP
seconds.short: An explosion at the third-phase unit of Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals at Kalavar, about 15 km from Mangaluru, around 12:25 on Wednesday was followed by fire and dense black smoke that spread towards Jokatte, Baala and Surathkal. A boiler is suspected; doors and windows were dislodged in nearby houses and the Jokatte panchayat building. Fire tenders from across the city were sent; casualties had not been confirmed by the cut.

why.text: MRPL is one of the state-run refiners that supply fuel across Karnataka; watch for word on how long the unit stays shut.

briefs.text: Sol costs $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output. briefs.headline: Shares steady after six-month lows as IT snaps an eight-day losing run
briefs.text: The Sensex and Nifty were slightly higher at the cut after two days of heavy selling; IT stocks rose as bets on a US rate rise eased, while hospitals fell. Foreign investors sold ₹4,968 crore on Tuesday, taking September's net outflow to ₹25,662 crore by NSDL's count. BofA now expects the RBI to raise the repo rate by 100 basis points through the first half of 2027.

briefs.headline: Fuel-efficiency rules for carmakers from 2027 give electric cars triple credit
briefs.text: The third phase of the Corporate Average Fuel Economy norms runs for five years from 1 April 2027. Each battery EV counts as three cars in a maker's fleet average, strong hybrids 1.6; small cars under 909 kg get no separate concession.
